summary: Tested new Integrators Wizard feature (iter 100): predictive search, scope branching (new vs expansion), expansion badge in grid, new 'Alcance del Proyecto' filter, and edit regression. All backend (4/4 pytest) and UI (7/7 critical assertions) tests pass. Created and cleaned up TEST_ integrators; no production data modified.

issues: Console hydration errors: <span> nested inside <tr>/<tbody> in the grid markup (React HTML validity warnings). Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: Optional: fix HTML hydration warnings in Integrators.jsx grid row (span inside tbody/tr).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /integrators/{id}/expand is idempotent and does NOT validate that the row currently has a non-expansion scope. Calling expand on an already-certified row silently overwrites integrator_status to 'En proceso' even if there was no real change of scope. Consider returning a 409 or no-op when project_scope is already 'expansion'.
Integrators.jsx is 1977 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; split wizard, grid, dialogs, bitacora and evolution into separate components/files.
expand endpoint has no RBAC check (any authenticated user can flip a row to expansion). Consider restricting to admin/canCreate.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED ephemeral TEST_ integrators (TEST_WIZ_*, TEST_EXP_*, TEST_UI_AMP_*). No production rows modified.
